name: Swiggy
description: Food delivery and Instamart quick commerce across Indian cities; also runs seat delivery on trains with IRCTC.
voice: Warm, quick, practical. Talks about customers and delivery partners.

name: Zomato
description: Food delivery and dining-out app; its parent Eternal Ltd also owns Blinkit.
voice: Witty but restrained. Customer-first, restaurant-partner friendly.

name: Zepto
description: Quick-commerce app delivering groceries and essentials in minutes from dark stores.

name: Blinkit
description: Quick-commerce service owned by Eternal Ltd, delivering groceries and more in minutes.

name: PhonePe
description: UPI payments app with insurance and wealth products; runs the Pincode quick-commerce app.

name: Paytm
description: Payments and financial services company (One97 Communications) serving consumers and merchants.

name: Razorpay
description: Payment gateway and business banking platform for Indian companies.

name: CRED
description: Members-only app for credit card bill payments, rewards and credit products.

name: Yulu
description: Shared electric two-wheelers; supplies DeX EVs to delivery partners of Zomato and Zepto.
voice: Earnest about clean mobility and rider livelihoods.

name: Bounce
description: Electric scooters and battery swapping; supplies EVs to Swiggy delivery partners.

name: Ola
description: Ride-hailing for cabs, autos and bike taxis (ANI Technologies).

name: Rapido
description: Bike-taxi, auto and cab platform; the largest bike-taxi player by most estimates.

name: Ather Energy
description: Electric scooter maker with its own fast-charging network.

name: IRCTC
description: Indian Railways' catering, e-ticketing and tourism arm; runs e-catering partnerships for meals on trains.

name: IndiGo
description: India's largest airline by domestic passengers.

name: MakeMyTrip
description: Online travel platform for flights, trains, buses and hotels.

name: Flipkart
description: E-commerce marketplace owned by Walmart; runs Flipkart Minutes for quick commerce.

name: Meesho
description: Value e-commerce marketplace for small sellers and first-time online shoppers.

name: Jio
description: Reliance Jio, telecom and digital services provider with 5G and AirFiber broadband.

name: Airtel
description: Bharti Airtel, telecom operator with mobile, broadband and Airtel Payments Bank.
